note: Data for electron/setup-plan.cjs chatModelFor. Tags, download sizes, context, capabilities and licence were read from ollama.com; the memory a tag needs (download size x 1.2) and every speed statement are FRIDAY estimates and stay unverified until the owner's PC runs them. A tag is never chosen unless its weights plus 20 percent fit the usable memory.

ollamaSettings.note: Applied by FRIDAY when it starts or calls Ollama, never forced on the owner's own Ollama setup. Ollama's default context is 4096. q8_0 KV cache only pays off at 16k context and more. Flash attention stays automatic because the sources disagree on Turing cards.

qualityFamilies.note: Ranking heuristic to decide whether a model already installed is at least as good as the tier choice: parameter count (MoE: geometric mean of total and active) times the family factor. Not a benchmark.
